summary: Frontend-only mobile UI/UX pass for CloudIVR (/cloudivr). Tested at 390x844 and regression at 1920x800 via Playwright. All requested features pass: slim phone top bar (logo/balance/inbox/softphone only), More menu with nav + settings (lang en/fr/es, private-mode switch, sign out), Escape/backdrop close, private mode masks numbers ('+1 ••• ••• 1429') + banner, FR translation ('Se déconnecter', 'Mode privé', 'Masquer les numéros et les messages') and back to EN, stacked card lists (UL) on phone for dashboard-activity, number-logs, wallet-deposits-table, wallet-history-table, campaign-leads-table; real TABLEs with headers on desktop. No horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390) on dashboard, wallet, inbox, number detail logs (also after opening note editor + text-back reply box), campaign detail, AI agents. number-logs-show-more 'Show 80 more' 20->40 rows. Note editor and Text back work inside cards. number-tabstrip scrolls (scrollLeft=650, active Logs tab in view on ?tab=logs); number-tab-* switches panels; ai-tab-* switches. Softphone close button 44x44 and closes panel. Mobile and desktop logout return to /cloudivr; /app then redirects to login. Desktop: sidebar visible (256px), bottom nav hidden, lang/private/logout in top bar, private toggle works.

issues: Banner copy says 'Tap the eye again to show them' but on phones the eye button is no longer in the top bar (it's under More > Private mode). Consider phone-specific copy or making the banner itself tappable to turn private mode off.
Inbox label truncates to 'Boîte de ré…' at 390px; consider a shorter FR short-label (e.g. 'Boîte' / 'Messages').

useIsPhone switches to cards below 768px but top bar/bottom nav switch at lg (1024px) — tablets get bottom nav + wide tables (overflow-x-auto). Not a bug, just note breakpoint mismatch; not tested in this run.

action_items: Optional: adjust private-mode banner wording on phones (eye button moved to More menu)
Optional: shorter French bottom-nav label for Inbox
critical_code_review_comments: MobileNav MoreSettings: 'Language', 'Private mode', 'Sign out' strings are hardcoded English but are translated at runtime by the i18n layer (verified FR) — OK.
Softphone panel stays mounted with opacity-0/pointer-events-none when closed; fine, but tests must check class rather than visibility.
